east.description: To the east lies A Narrow Strait between two Icebergs.

10785.description:
The current is gentle here, clear enough to see the bottom. Shallow
water laps around stones and reeds. Ways lead north and east.

west.description: To the west lies A Narrow Strait between two Icebergs.

10786.description:
Mud and pebbles shift beneath the slow water. Shallow water laps around
stones and reeds. Ways lead south and west.

10787.name: The Quiet Bay beyond the Ice Wall

north.description: To the north lies A Narrow Strait between two Icebergs.

10787.description:
Wildflowers dot the meadow, and insects hum among them. A worn track
crosses the open ground. A way leads north.

east.description: To the east lies The South-Eastern Mira Retrum.

10798.description:
The far shore is a smudge on the horizon. Deep water stretches away,
dark and restless. Ways lead north, east and west.
